description: k-mer Jaccard index |A∩B|/|A∪B| (exact, or Mash bottom-s MinHash estimate with sketchSize > 0), the Mash distance -ln(2J/(1+J))/k (Ondov et al. 2016), the Mash p-value and x/s in sketch mode, and the exact containment indices |A∩B|/|A|, |A∩B|/|B| (Koslicki & Zabeti 2019). canonical=true gives Mash/sourmash k-mers.

canonical.description: Canonical k-mers min(w, revcomp(w)), non-ACGT windows skipped (mash dist default, sourmash, jellyfish -C)

acgtOnly.description: Skip k-mers containing a non-ACGT symbol (mash sketch -n)

sketchSize.description: 0 = exact sets (default); s > 0 = Mash MinHash sketch size (mash -s; Mash default 1000), MurmurHash3_x64_128 seed 42, k <= 32

jaccard.description: Jaccard index in [0,1]; 0 when both k-mer sets are empty

mashDistance.description: Mash distance in [0,1] (0 for identical sets, 1 when no k-mer is shared, capped at 1)

containmentSeq1InSeq2.description: Exact containment |A∩B|/|A| (0 when A is empty)

containmentSeq2InSeq1.description: Exact containment |A∩B|/|B| (0 when B is empty)

sharedHashes.description: Sketch mode: shared hashes x of Mash's x/s; null in exact mode

sketchDenominator.description: Sketch mode: union hashes compared (denominator of x/s); null in exact mode

pValue.description: Sketch mode: Mash p-value P(X >= x), X ~ Binomial(denominator, r); null in exact mode

errors.message: Sequence cannot be null or empty
